scripts.test:integration: uv run --locked --extra ontology --extra linkml --extra tabular --extra documents pytest -m 'integration and not notebook'
scripts.test:notebook: uv run --locked --group notebook --extra ontology --extra linkml --extra tabular pytest -m notebook
